items.title: Planning for 99.99 percent availability with the Amazon Cognito Plus feature plan
items.summary: Amazon Cognito handles sign-in and access control for users, AI agents, and microservices with managed user directories, social and enterprise federation, and passwordless sign-in with passkeys or one-time passwords. Sign-in is the front door to your application. If your customer identity and access management (CIAM) layer is unavailable, users can’t sign in or refresh their […]
